articles.availability_note: Sony’s October22 announcement reports a1×1mm chip,720×720 pixels,30/60fps and5m digital transmission confirmed in its own AWG44-cable evaluation. Chip size is not completed-scope diameter;5m is cable length,not insertion depth. Industry-first claim is Sony-researched and category-limited. November2026 samples are planned. Component is not a medical device and not evaluated/approved for medical applications; Sony excludes intended HongKong medical use. No patient benefit,infection reduction,cost or lifecycle advantage is established here. Other testing/integration not reported by this release must not be declared nonexistent. Illustration is imagined,not product or clinical evidence.
